Application Data.NAME: Sunshine Learning Center
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunshine Learning Center provides a safe and nurturing environment for children aged 6 weeks to 12 years, focusing on early childhood education and development through engaging activities. Our center offers music, dance, and arts-and-crafts classes as supplementary programs, ensuring individualized attention within a mixed-age setting. All staff members have undergone comprehensive background checks and are trained in child protection policies. We host occasional events such as recitals and showcases, which are managed with appropriate liability coverage. With a strong emphasis on safety protocols, our facility maintains a clean regulatory history and adheres to state-mandated licensing requirements, ensuring a high staff-to-child ratio and proper supervision at all times.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a minor slip and fall incident occurred on the playground, resulting in a $1,200 claim for medical expenses. The claim has been closed, and the center implemented additional safety measures to prevent future incidents.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: B rated safe, UL listed, Class II, 1200 lbs capacity
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing around the playground and facility, with a 24-hour monitored alarm system and regular patrol by security personnel during events.
